body:
CHANGELOG updated in EmilyOS: Real rootfs (not synthetic) confirmed booting into OpenRC once /sbin/init exists -- root-lessly verified via a safe busybox --list check + hand-created symlink on a throwaway test copy. OpenRC caches service deps and finds /etc/init.d/emilyos. Confirms the privileged busybox --install trigger step is load-bearing and forecasts the real build should boot further once it runs. (sess-20260905-0720-ec33e7c5)
